title: Memories and the Force
description: As Kylo Ren looks out over the oceans of Kef Bir, he hears a familiar voice. "Hey kid," the voice mutters, and Ren turns to see his father, Han Solo, standing before him. Though appearance is just a memory, it is just what Ren needed to push him back into the light. Kylo Ren is dead, and Ben Solo has returned.
